Job Title Modern Workplace Engineer About Us Ingersoll Rand is a global provider of mission-critical flow creation, life science and industrial solutions. Ingersoll Rand’s Global Engineering & Technology Center (GEC) in Bangalore, A GREAT PLACE TO WORK CERTIFIED WORKPLACE is driven by an ownership mindset and entrepreneurial spirit, has been a beacon of innovation for over 19 years, embodying our purpose to “Make Life Better” for our employees, customers, shareholders and the planet. The Engineering & Technology center has expertly supported a diverse range of industrial products, offering deep expertise in core and digital engineering space. By cultivating a sense of inclusion, belonging and respect, and a collaborative culture, the GEC has fostered the most talented and capable engineers, thereby playing a pivotal role in driving Ingersoll Rand’s purpose and strategic focus areas. Job & Division Summary The Modern Workplace Engineer designs, supports, and continuously improves Microsoft 365 workplace services that enable secure collaboration, productivity, automation, and AI-enabled ways of working across the enterprise. This role partners with IT, security, business stakeholders, and platform owners to operate and govern core services including Teams, SharePoint, Exchange, Power Platform, Copilot, and related Microsoft 365 capabilities. Responsibilities The Modern Workplace Engineer is responsible for the daily operation, governance, and continuous improvement of Microsoft 365 workplace platforms, with an emphasis on secure collaboration, user experience, automation, and measurable service outcomes. Administer and support Microsoft 365 services including Teams, SharePoint, OneDrive, Exchange, Entra ID-integrated experiences, and related collaboration workloads. Implement and maintain governance standards for Teams, SharePoint sites, groups, guest access, third-party apps, ownership, lifecycle management, and service configuration. Support Power Platform governance, including environment management, security groups, admin roles, managed environment adoption, and app or flow lifecycle practices. Contribute to Microsoft Copilot and workplace AI governance by supporting readiness, monitoring, policy alignment, app deployment, user enablement, and secure adoption practices. Troubleshoot and resolve incidents, service requests, and escalations across modern workplace platforms while improving knowledge articles, runbooks, and repeatable support processes. Use PowerShell, Microsoft admin centers, reporting tools, and automation to improve operational efficiency, reduce manual work, and maintain accurate platform data. Partner with security, infrastructure, service desk, application, and business teams to deliver reliable workplace technology solutions aligned to enterprise standards. Mandatory Requirements Experience administering Microsoft 365 services such as Teams, SharePoint, OneDrive, Exchange, Microsoft 365 admin center, and Entra ID-connected workloads. Working knowledge of Microsoft 365 governance, access management, lifecycle management, service health, compliance concepts, and enterprise collaboration controls. Experience with PowerShell, administrative scripting, reporting, or automation to support platform operations and repeatable processes. Ability to troubleshoot technical issues, document findings, create runbooks or knowledge articles, and communicate clearly with technical and non-technical audiences. Bachelor’s degree in information technology, computer science, related field, or equivalent practical experience. Core Competencies Customer-focused problem solving and service ownership Strong documentation, process discipline, and operational follow-through Collaboration across technical teams, business stakeholders, and support organizations Desired Skills Microsoft certifications related to Microsoft 365, Teams, SharePoint, Exchange, Security, or Power Platform. Experience supporting Microsoft Copilot, Copilot Studio, agent lifecycle management, AI governance, or responsible AI adoption programs. Experience with ServiceNow, ITIL-based support processes, SLA reporting, dashboards, or operational metrics. Experience with Power Platform managed environments, pipelines, security roles, data loss prevention policies, or environment cleanup activities. Experience working in a global enterprise environment with cross-functional IT, security, and business teams. Travel & Work Arrangements/Requirements Fully site based, flexible working, hybrid What We Offer We are all owners of the company! Stock options (Employee Ownership Program) that align your interests with the company's success. Yearly performance-based bonus, rewarding your hard work and dedication. Leave Encashments Maternity/Paternity Leaves Employee Health covered under Medical, Group Term Life & Accident Insurance Employee Assistance Program Employee development with LinkedIn Learning Employee recognition via Awardco Collaborative, multicultural work environment with a team of dedicated professionals, fostering innovation and teamwork. Ingersoll Rand Inc. (NYSE:IR), driven by an entrepreneurial spirit and ownership mindset, is dedicated to helping make life better for our employees, customers and communities. Customers lean on us for our technology-driven excellence in mission-critical flow creation and industrial solutions across 40+ respected brands where our products and services excel in the most complex and harsh conditions. Our employees develop customers for life through their daily commitment to expertise, productivity and efficiency. For more information, visit www.IRCO.com.

review_candidates.title: Engineer / Scientist / Technical or Mechanical Expert
review_candidates.description: When joining the EPO, relocation to the country of one of our duty stations (Munich, The Hague, Vienna or Berlin) is required. This means you need to reside in the country of your duty station (Germany, Austria or the Netherlands). You are not required to live in the city itself. _____________________________________________________________________________ Duration of contract: Five years, renewable (full-time) Location: Hybrid based in Germany (Munich/Berlin) or the Netherlands (The Hague) Application deadline: 02.11.2026 At the European Patent Office (EPO), we explore breakthrough technologies before they reach the public. As a patent examiner, you'll assess whether inventions meet the criteria for patent protection, and in doing so support innovation that improves lives, drives industries and shapes the future. We are an inclusive, purpose-driven organisation committed to sustainability, fairness and excellence – diversity is part of our DNA. Whether you come from research, academia or industry, if you're curious, open to learning and looking for a meaningful intellectual challenge you'll find your place at the EPO. Your role and impact As a Patent Examiner, you will: examine patent applications – including technical documentation and drawings – in one of our official languages (English, French or German) analyse new inventions to evaluate their novelty and inventive step conduct in-depth research using digital search tools, scientific databases and patent information sources to identify the most relevant prior art apply legal and procedural frameworks to make clear, high-quality decisions on whether a patent should be granted communicate your findings clearly and constructively with applicants and other parties collaborate with international colleagues in a diverse and inclusive environment maintain high-quality standards with strong attention to detail and scientific rigour contribute to Europe's innovation ecosystem by ensuring fair and consistent application of the European Patent Convention (EPC) and related legal texts Your profile We're looking for expertise in these fields: Applied Maths, AI, and Quantum Computing: artificial intelligence/machine learning, applied math & NLP, quantum computing Computer: ICT security or cryptography, network security, image processing, AR/AV, HCI, GUI, computer devices, AI applications, error detection & correction, distributed processing & CPU, software execution Electrical Engineering & Power Systems Electric Power Distribution & Protection (photovoltaic systems, wind turbines, hydropower plants etc, to grid/power networks) via AC and/or DC lines (including HVDC), power conversion, energy storage, wireless power transfer and battery charging technologies (e.g. EVs/HEVs charging) Electromechanics – electrical connectors Electrical Connectors, Electrical Connectors & Displays - coupling devices, terminals, and current collectors across automotive (including high-voltage/EV systems), industrial, and consumer applications. Key areas include electromechanical contact design, busbar assemblies, termination technologies (crimping, IDC, welding), board-to-board and cable-to-board interconnects, electromagnetic shielding (EMI/EMC), and mechanical latching and environmental sealing. Video Engineering: digital video coding and compression (MPEG, HEVC, VVC, point cloud), video transmission (DVB, ISOBMFF, HbbTV), digital cameras, image sensors and camera control Mechanical Engineering: Tobacco processing and aerosol generation, Air Conditioning, Heating Systems, Conveyors, Furniture and Hand Tools Medical Device Engineering: Medical Mechanics - design, development, testing or manufacture of medical devices and surgical technologies. Minimally invasive devices: catheters, guidewires, delivery systems; Drug delivery: microneedles, injectors and related devices; Surgical devices: surgical instruments, powered and robotic surgical systems; Spinal implants: pedicle screws, rods, intervertebral cages, disc prostheses Semiconductors: Semiconductor manufacturing technology, Lithography Technologies, Magnetic Applications and Electromagnetic Components, Lithography Chemistry (Photoresists & Photomasks), Physical aspects of OLED displays, lighting devices and organic photovoltaic devices, Semiconductor devices and manufacturing technology Telecom & Wireless : Messaging, Topology, Access, Multiple Access & Transmission Lines, Network Management, PowerSaving, Sync, SatCom, Resource Allocation, Wireless & Data Networks You will thrive with us if you have a solid background and relevant expertise in the specified fields, built up during your studies, in projects, and/or as a result of professional experience enjoy deep technical analysis, reading technical drawings and solving intellectual puzzles are genuinely curious about technology and enjoy continuously learning about new scientific developments, emerging technologies and patent law are analytical, detail-oriented and open-minded are confident using digital technologies and AI-supported tools to analyse information while applying own critical thinking value both independent work and team collaboration are comfortable making structured, evidence-based decisions and exercising sound professional judgement No prior IP (intellectual property) experience? No problem, we provide full training to get you started. Our minimum requirements for this post diploma of completed studies at master's level covering one or more technical fields mentioned above excellent knowledge (at least C1) of one of our official languages (English, French and German) and the ability to understand the other two; alternatively, excellent knowledge (at least C1) of English (in such cases, the willingness to learn the missing languages and to reach level B2 within a set time frame would be required) work experience in industry would be an advantage citizenship of one of the member states of the European Patent Organisation What we offer competitive salary: €7 076 to €10 164 net/month (depending on location and experience) 30+ days of annual leave + flexible working arrangements generous remote work policy: work from anywhere in the country of employment; up to 60 days from abroad (EPC states) family-friendly policies: childcare, education and relocation support pension and insurance: excellent social security coverage examiner training: a comprehensive two-year development programme covering all aspects of patent search and examination, starting with a six-week Academy programme on-site and delivered in English inclusive culture: 35+ nationalities, supportive networks and a strong DEI commitment facilities: on-site gym, health services, staff clubs and more (depending on location) top locations: high quality of life and a thriving international community (see full list of benefits) What to expect next We are recruiting for positions starting from 2027 and are already building a talent pool for upcoming roles in 2028. If selected to join our talent pool, you'll get: priority access to future vacancies exclusive access to learning offers and resources to enhance your IP awareness and your readiness to become a patent examiner regular updates and insights Being a member of the talent pool gives you a chance to join our journey from the very beginning and to be fully prepared for when the next positions go live. Process The successful candidate will be selected on the basis of qualifications, competencies, professional experience and language knowledge, supplemented as appropriate by technical assessments, interviews and/or a personality questionnaire. A talent pool (reserve list) will be constituted should more candidates than required at this time be considered suitable following the selection procedure. Such talent pools are valid for a period of 24 months and talent pool candidates may be contacted should a vacancy with substantially the same profile arise during that period. In line with the EPO's values and the standards of honesty and integrity expected of its employees, candidates are expected to uphold these same principles throughout the selection process. We recognise that AI tools may be used to support the preparation of job applications. Candidates nevertheless remain responsible for the content of their application and for the accuracy of the information submitted – and we encourage candidates to ensure that their job application remains an authentic reflection of their own qualifications, skills and experience. During interviews and assessments, candidates are expected to rely on their own knowledge, experience and judgement, without the use of AI tools or other forms of real-time assistance, unless explicitly stated otherwise.
